Cyber Industry
Embed cybersecurity across your value chain to enhance resilience
Integrate cybersecurity measures across operations to counter evolving cyber threats ensure compliance and compete in your industry.
Why cyber industry matters
With cybercrime costs projected to hit $10.5 trillion annually by 2025, urgent action is essential. Businesses must address industry specific risk, enhance cyber resilience, secure digital transactions, and protect sensitive data. Implementing robust cybersecurity measures can ensure operational continuity, regulatory compliance and sustained trust, safeguarding against evolving threats.

How cyber industry is changing
Businesses in every industry are embedding cybersecurity across the value chain to build resilience against evolving cyber threats. This involves securing industrial systems, technology platforms, digital transactions, and sensitive data. The focus is on enhancing operational reliability, regulatory compliance, and trust, while empowering you to adapt to new paradigms like cloud, remote work and IoT.
What you can do
Secure your technology platforms and communications networks
Embrace AI, 5G, IOT/OT with secure technology platforms and communication networks. This helps  reduce cyber risk, ensure compliance with recent regulations, and embed security by design in fast-paced product cycles.
Enhance operational integrity in financial services
Enable secure digital transactions to more efficiently manage regulatory compliance and improve trust with customers. Implement strong security measures for systems and monitor risk to ensure reliability in a post-quantum world.
Strengthen national resilience and protect public assets
Build national resilience and safeguard public assets to meet government needs. Ensure trusted services, adapt to evolving threats, and build secure digital frameworks that protect citizens and critical infrastructure.
Safeguard health data to ensure service continuity
Implement comprehensive security solutions across health and public services to protect sensitive data, ensure compliance, and adapt to evolving cyber threats. These measures help you maintain both operational integrity and public trust.
Enable secure development of trustworthy products
Unlock, safeguard and sustain business growth and protect customer trust by securing the evolution of product design and manufacturing.
What you’ll achieve
Ultra-secure technology platforms and communications networks
Communications, media and technology organizations can defend themselves against rising threats with industry-focused cybersecurity measures.
Improved trust and compliance in the financial sector
Financial organizations that embrace secure transactions can efficiently manage regulatory compliance and improve trust with customers.
Protected healthcare organizations and patients
De-risk healthcare infrastructure and the connected devices providing patient care with industry-focused secure solutions.
Higher resilience within the public sector
Public sector organizations can safeguard their data and managing regulatory compliance to increase overall resiliency.
Confidence in and quality across products and manufacturing
Maintain customer trust by securing product development and manufacturing operations as they evolve.
